question: Is the Alibaba Cloud Agent Sandbox (ACS) a separate offer from compute/alibaba-agentrun, which prices the Chinese-language Agent Sandbox / FC / AgentRun with a 15 GiB free disk allowance?
why: The new draft prices the international Flash Edition at default QoS with a 30 GiB active-storage allowance on https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cs/user-guide/agent-sandbox/; the existing record prices the Chinese-language billing overview with CNY rates and 15 GiB. The two packages differ on tier and region, so the integrator must decide whether they are two offers or one.
